items.title: Build a multi-team AI and analytics environment on Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio with Terraform
items.summary: Learn how to use the Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio Terraform module to provision a multi-team AI and analytics platform (domains, blueprints, project profiles, and projects) for data analytics, machine learning, and generative AI teams in a single terraform apply, with shared governance and least-privilege security defined entirely as code.
items.creator: Harshi Surampalli

items.title: How Samsung Ads federated Snowflake Iceberg tables using Amazon Cognito
items.summary: Learn how Samsung Ads federates Snowflake-managed Apache Iceberg tables into AWS Lake Formation and queries them from Amazon Athena using Amazon Cognito for OAuth2 machine-to-machine authentication, with no second copy of the data to maintain.
items.creator: Balaji Selva Rajan

items.title: Allocate shared Amazon MSK costs to Kafka topics for cost visibility
items.summary: Amazon MSK bills at the cluster level, with no per-topic breakdown. This post shows how to allocate shared MSK cluster costs to individual Kafka topics by combining AWS Cost and Usage Report billing with per-topic CloudWatch or Prometheus metrics, giving each team a usage-based view of its spend.
items.creator: Durai Krishnan
categories: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)
